scripts.postinstall: node -e "if(process.platform!=='win32'){const cp=require('child_process'),fs=require('fs'); ['bin','universal-video-downloader/bin'].forEach(d=>fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true})); try{cp.execSync('curl -L https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases/latest/download/yt-dlp -o bin/yt-dlp && chmod a+rx bin/yt-dlp && cp bin/yt-dlp universal-video-downloader/bin/yt-dlp',{stdio:'inherit'});}catch(e){console.warn('yt-dlp setup note:', e.message);}}"
